verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say Gitea Actions is compatible with GitHub Actions. They say users can write familiar YAML workflows that reuse existing Actions plugins, and that 'thousands of existing GitHub Actions' can run inside Gitea instances, which directly covers reusing community-built actions. The evidence is only short first-party claims, though; an old community remark that Gitea avoids bundling CI predates Actions and does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: detailed docs on compatibility scope and limits (e.g. which GitHub Actions features or marketplace actions work), and independent or hands-on confirmation that community actions run successfully.
